lessons.title: Hello, World!
lessons.description: Meet someone, introduce yourself, and start a friendly conversation.

quiz.question: Which phrase introduces you?
quiz.explanation: “My name is…” is used for introductions.

quiz.question: Someone says, “Nice to meet you.” What is a natural reply?
quiz.explanation: Add “too” to return the friendly greeting.

lessons.title: At the Café
lessons.description: Order a drink politely and understand a simple café conversation.

phrases.english: Could I have a coffee, please?

phrases.meaning: The server asks if you want more.

quiz.question: Which word makes a request more polite?
What can you say when your order is complete?
quiz.explanation: “That’s all” means you do not need anything more.

lessons.title: Find the Way
lessons.description: Ask for directions and follow common instructions around town.

phrases.english: Excuse me, where is the station?
phrases.meaning: A polite way to ask for a location.

quiz.question: What does “go straight” mean?
quiz.explanation: Going straight means continuing in the same direction.

quiz.question: How should you begin a polite question to a stranger?

lessons.title: Smart Shopping
lessons.description: Ask about prices, sizes, and paying for something you like.

phrases.english: Do you have this in a larger size?

phrases.meaning: Say you want to buy it.

quiz.question: You decide to buy something. What do you say?
quiz.explanation: “I’ll take it” tells the seller you want to buy the item.

quiz.question: Which question asks about price?
quiz.explanation: “How much” is used to ask the price.

lessons.title: Make Plans
lessons.description: Invite a friend, suggest a time, and respond naturally.

phrases.english: Would you like to see a movie?

quiz.question: Which phrase is an invitation?
options: Would you like to see a movie?
quiz.explanation: “Would you like to…” is a common invitation pattern.

quiz.question: What does “That sounds great” communicate?
quiz.explanation: It shows that you like and accept the suggestion.

lessons.title: Travel Day
lessons.description: Navigate check-in and ask the essential questions on a trip.

phrases.meaning: Ask where to check in for your flight.
A staff member asks for your passport.
Ask when passengers can enter the plane.

quiz.question: Which document might staff ask to see?
quiz.explanation: A passport is the travel document used for international flights.

quiz.question: What is “boarding”?
quiz.explanation: Boarding is the process of passengers entering the aircraft.
